name: matched-ks3-all-dense2816-fp8-normlr
hypothesis: Normalize only dense KS3 projection learning rate by sqrt(1024/2816), canceling the larger ANVIL shape factor at dense width2816. The effective dense multiplier becomes sqrt(1024/768), matching the original all-KS3 width1024 arm while retaining the original MLP dense capacity. Keep the correctness-validated, whole-model faster dense FP8 path, BF16 routed KS3, geometry Adam0.125, rank1, and all shared/model-wide settings. Earlier width1536 normalized-rate and default-rate trials were both proxy-pruned and provide no validation ranking; this is the corresponding untested width2816 rate hypothesis.
